mapper.select: SELECT social_id AS socialId, provider, provider_user_id AS providerUserId, connected_at AS connectedAt, user_id AS userId FROM SOCIAL_LOGIN WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, u.user_name, r.role_code AS roleCode FROM USER u LEFT JOIN USER_ROLE ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN ROLE r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER ( email, password, nickname, user_name, birth_date, gender, profile_image, login_type, status, is_terms_agreed, is_privacy_agreed, is_marketing_agreed ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{userName}, #{birthDateSql,jdbcType=DATE}, #{gender}, #{profile_image}, #{login_type}, #{status}, #{termsAgreed}, #{privacyAgreed}, #{marketingAgreed} )
INSERT INTO SOCIAL_LOGIN ( user_id, provider, provider_user_id, connected_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, NOW() )
